args.query: public school enrollment by district or state NCES

sql: SELECT "year", leaid, lea_name, enrollment, teachers_total_fte FROM edu.ccd_districts WHERE (lea_name ILIKE 'Seattle%' OR lea_name ILIKE 'San Francisco Unified%') AND "year" IN (2019,2020,2023,2024) ORDER BY lea_name, "year"

SELECT "year", SUM(CASE WHEN enrollment>0 THEN enrollment END) enr, SUM(CASE WHEN teachers_total_fte>0 THEN teachers_total_fte END) tch, COUNT(*) n FROM edu.ccd_districts WHERE "year" IN (2019,2020,2021,2022,2023,2024) GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"

SELECT SUM(a.teachers_total_fte) t19, SUM(b.teachers_total_fte) t24, SUM(a.enrollment) e19, SUM(b.enrollment) e24, COUNT(*) n FROM edu.ccd_districts a JOIN edu.ccd_districts b ON a.leaid=b.leaid AND a."year"=2019 AND b."year"=2024 WHERE a.teachers_total_fte>0 AND b.teachers_total_fte>0 AND a.enrollment>0 AND b.enrollment>0

SELECT COUNT(*) n_schools_both, SUM(CASE WHEN b.enrollment <= 0.85*a.enrollment THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) down15 FROM edu.ccd_schools a JOIN edu.ccd_schools b ON a.ncessch=b.ncessch AND a."year"=2019 AND b."year"=2024 WHERE a.enrollment>0 AND b.enrollment>=0
